name: Green Hag
summary: A swamp hag that mimics voices, claws foes, casts illusions, and works coven magic.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.text: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {dc:int}): *{ref:spell/augury}*, *{ref:spell/find-familiar}*, *{ref:spell/identify}*, *{ref:spell/locate-object}*, *{ref:spell/scrying}*, or *{ref:spell/unseen-servant}*. The hag must finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful {dc:str} Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

atWill.note: self only, and the hag leaves no tracks while Invisible
